answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The spiral cap is enforced at intake and nebula publishes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a zenith tag. That is 21 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
